notes.title: Update notes for 1.25
notes.notes:
new! added 104 new level sets with 3,250 new levels, for a total of 60,510 levels
 updated daily rewards display
 updated inventory display
 score doubler timer spans all games instead of being unique to each game
 various bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.24
notes.notes:
new! added 208 new level sets with 6,500 new levels, for a total of 57,260 levels
 new! ability to search avatar catalog by animal
 new! added a clock to the playing screen that shows the current time
 updated avatar browser from page by page to scrollable and include animal name

notes.title: 1.22 Update Notes
notes.notes:

 various bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes for 1.21
notes.notes:
- new! added 104 new level sets with 3,250 new levels, for a total of 47,410 levels
- new! added new baby animal avatars: with no outfits, as artists, as chefs, as detectives, wearing gowns, and wearing kimonos
- re-authored original avatars to have better quality
- updated help

notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.notes:
new! added 104 new level sets with 3,250 new levels, for a total of 44,160 levels
 updated home screen
 re-worked play area information architecture
 as part of re-work, changed score doubler indicator to a stop watch with a countdown underneath
 as part of re-work, updated help
 made Thor (lightning destruction) off by default; enable/disable in settings
 removed legacy avatars
 fixed selection bugs on tab menu (icons on the bottom of the non-play area)
